rationale: Human-approved Orval boundary: generated callers supply the complete response type. Validating the unknown payload here would change existing runtime response behavior.
evidence: https://orval.dev/docs/guides/custom-client/ requires a generic custom client. Existing JSON, text, binary, bodyless, and error response tests preserve the generated response contract. Approved by Sean Keever on 2026-09-24.
